dj.line:
Fee pinned at that flag-only number, one side sitting on the zero address — raw ether with no bodyguard and a rake the house can crank once your chips are already committed. That's not a market, that's a hand of three-card monte with the dealer's fingers on the cards.

You came to play — so tell me, how much are you willing to lose to a rulebook that rewrites itself mid-hand?
